title: Sonnet 5 Replay Receipt
description: Receipt for the controlled replay of a representative prompt corpus under Claude Sonnet 5 tokenization, capturing token-count delta, cost delta, eval-score delta, and behavior-change scan results. Required before Sonnet 5 can be admitted as a default route. Motivated by the Anthropic release notes (Jun 30 2026) stating Sonnet 5 uses a new tokenizer that produces roughly 30% more tokens for the same text, with per-token pricing unchanged at standard $3/$15 per million tokens — meaning a real ~30% effective cost increase after introductory pricing expires Aug 31 2026. Also captures the 3 migration-breaking behavior changes: adaptive thinking default-on, manual extended thinking returning 400, and non-default sampling parameters returning 400.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of replay execution.

prompt_corpus_ref.description: Reference to the prompt corpus replayed (path, URL, or corpus ID). Must be non-empty and replayable.

replay_methodology.description: token_counting_api = used /v1/messages/count_tokens with model=claude-sonnet-5; side_by_side_eval = ran evals on both models; full_replay = replayed entire corpus with outputs; sampled_replay = replayed a representative sample.

corpus_size_prompts.description: Number of prompts in the replayed corpus.

sonnet_46_token_count.description: Total token count under Sonnet 4.6 tokenization.

sonnet_5_token_count.description: Total token count under Sonnet 5 tokenization.

token_delta_ratio.description: sonnet_5_token_count / sonnet_46_token_count. Expected ~1.0-1.35 per Anthropic; community measurements show 1.27-1.47 for code/English.

token_delta_pct.description: Percentage token increase: (sonnet_5 - sonnet_46) / sonnet_46 * 100. Positive = Sonnet 5 uses more tokens.

standard_pricing_per_1m_input_usd.description: Standard per-million-input-token pricing in USD. $3 for both Sonnet 4.6 and Sonnet 5.

standard_pricing_per_1m_output_usd.description: Standard per-million-output-token pricing in USD. $15 for both Sonnet 4.6 and Sonnet 5.

introductory_pricing_per_1m_input_usd.description: Introductory per-million-input-token pricing in USD. $2 for Sonnet 5 through Aug 31 2026.

introductory_pricing_per_1m_output_usd.description: Introductory per-million-output-token pricing in USD. $10 for Sonnet 5 through Aug 31 2026.

introductory_pricing_expires_at.description: When introductory pricing expires. 2026-08-31T23:59:59Z for Sonnet 5.

sonnet_46_cost_usd.description: Total cost under Sonnet 4.6 at standard pricing.

sonnet_5_cost_usd.description: Total cost under Sonnet 5 at standard pricing (NOT introductory — standard is the durable cost).

cost_delta_pct.description: Percentage cost increase at standard pricing: (sonnet_5 - sonnet_46) / sonnet_46 * 100.

sonnet_5_cost_introductory_usd.description: Total cost under Sonnet 5 at introductory pricing (temporary, for comparison only).

eval_name.description: Name of the evaluation (e.g. BrowseComp, HumanEval, MMLU).

methodology_note.description: Note on eval methodology (e.g. 'replayed with 10M token budget per Anthropic guidance').

eval_scores.description: Side-by-side eval scores. Required when replay_methodology is side_by_side_eval or full_replay.

behavior_changes_detected.description: Behavior changes detected during replay. adaptive_thinking_default_on = thinking is now on by default; manual_extended_thinking_returns_400 = thinking:{type:enabled,budget_tokens:N} returns 400; non_default_sampling_returns_400 = non-default temperature/top_p/top_k return 400; prompt_cache_invalidated_on_model_switch = cached prefixes invalidated; context_window_holds_less_text = 1M window holds less text due to tokenizer.

max_tokens_truncation_observed.description: Whether any output was truncated due to max_tokens limits tuned for Sonnet 4.6 being too low for Sonnet 5.

prompt_cache_invalidated.description: Whether prompt cache was invalidated by the model switch (expected true on first switch).

content_type.description: Content type of the prompt subset.

content_type_breakdown.description: Token delta broken down by content type. Anthropic states 1.0-1.35x; community shows English 1.42x, Spanish 1.33x, Chinese 1.01x, Python 1.27x.

admission_recommendation.description: admit = safe to admit as default route; conditional = admit with documented conditions; hold = do not admit yet, more replay needed; reject = do not admit (cost/quality/behavior breakage too severe).

admission_conditions.description: Conditions that must be met if admission_recommendation=conditional (e.g. 'recount all prompts with token counting API', 'revise max_tokens to 1.3x Sonnet 4.6 values', 'disable adaptive thinking for tool-use routes').

operator_approval_ref.description: Reference to operator approval if admission_recommendation=admit or conditional (e.g. PR comment URL, risk acceptance ID). Required for admit and conditional.

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence (Anthropic blog URL, token counting API output, eval results).

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical receipt (excluding the hash field). Tamper detection.
